name: DmiMag LiveBlog. Live broadcast
author: dmimag

sections.description:
Live text broadcasts on your site while you’re in the thick of things.
Breaking news, concerts, sporting events, conference, etc.
Keep your readers up to date.

DmiMag LiveBlog. Live broadcast – is a lightweight WordPress live broadcast Plugin.
Create an unlimited of Live broadcast that easily fit into your website design.

Key Features

  • Unlimited number of Live broadcast
  • WYSIWYG editor use
  • Automatically generated shortcodes
  • Easy to integrate into website design
sections.installation:
1. Upload dmimag-liveblog to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Create first Live broadcast
  4. Place shortcode in your post or page
